gloss: unusual; distinctive; one of a kind

definitions.gloss: unusual; distinctive; one of a kind
definitions.explanation: Standing out from the rest in an unusual and interesting way, as a career, background, pairing or work unlike others in its field.

examples.japanese: {異色|いしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異色|いしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧だ。
examples.english: The two of them make an unusual duo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{異色|いしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: A writer with the unusual background of being a former doctor has published a new novel.

notes:
Usually before a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, and positive or neutral: something unusual that draws interest. Common in news, reviews and introductions.
